title: Peripheral motion distraction during central reading
statement:
The human eye's peripheral vision is highly optimized for detecting motion, making even minor animated elements on the screen's edge highly distracting during central reading tasks.

Options:
- Focus Preservation: Static peripheral elements (fits: documentation sidebars, blog layouts)
- Intentional Disruption: Pulsing peripheral badge (fits: chat support prompts, urgent system warnings)
- Severe Distraction: Auto-playing peripheral video (fits: avoid in content heavy apps)
appliesWhen: Applies to: sidebars, floating action buttons, ad banners. Audience: general.
